unfold1d_tensor: unfold a TxBxC PyTorch tensor to TxBxCxK using a specified kernel size and left padding
unfold1d_with_padding: unfold a 3D tensor with custom left padding and pad value for sequence windowing
unfold1d_kernel_one: unfold a tensor with kernel size 1 to add a trailing dimension via unsqueeze
review_unfold1d_strided: review the unfold1d function that uses as_strided to create sliding window views of a tensor
summarize_unfold1d: summarize the unfold1d function that pads and strides a TxBxC tensor into TxBxCxK shape
